status: Declared before native paid timing. Admission variable rename, explicit bool annotation and exact JSON numeric cleanup checks repaired harness only; all thresholds unchanged.
correctness_prerequisite: All 13 native functional cases, all 22 paid draw cases in both orders, exact RGBA/state/event/packet/cache/path/cleanup/source gates and strict logs must pass.

primary_per_process_gate.applies_to: Each primary case separately in both fresh forward and reverse processes
primary_per_process_gate.threshold_composition: Both fractional and absolute mean-saving requirements must hold.

order_gate: Retain actual invocation-order strata; a mean direction reversal across order strata defers promotion even if pooled means pass.
negative_controls: Other positive-work cases must not show a repeatable greater-than-5-percent p95 regression in both processes. Preserve individual outliers/maxima; one noisy maximum is not a causal conclusion.
decision: Below threshold, mixed process/order signs, or reproducible tail regressions means defer/withdraw the candidate rather than carry its guard complexity for a microbenchmark-only win.
limits: Elapsed native draw submission only; phase-correlated samples, host memory pressure and shared cache order remain limitations. This is a promotion screen, not a statistical power claim, full-game CPU share, GPU/present result or FPS improvement.
